name: Neon arcade (restrained)
one_line: Thin bright lines on dark indigo; light used sparingly.
look_words: An arcade look that keeps its light under control. Dark indigo surfaces with a slight gloss; thin crisp lines in magenta and cyan along edges, lanes and gates; a low skyline of plain dark blocks. Nine tenths of the screen stays dark so the lines stay sharp. The player is cyan, pickups are yellow, the goal is green, and magenta means harm. Shapes are simple geometry: triangles, grids, rings. Glow is small and tight around each line, never a haze over the picture. Motion is fast and clean: short light trails, quick flashes on hits, a pulsing grid in time with the music. Avoid heavy bloom, purple fog, lens flares, chrome, more than four bright colours and flashing that strains the eyes.

palette.name: dark arcade
palette.notes: Use the bright colours as thin lines and small shapes on dark surfaces. If you add bloom, keep it very low (about 0.15) or the lines turn to fog.

look_wish: thin glowing outlines on dark fills, very little bloom
